93:t_1:89.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're with the Space Force. Isn't this a treaty violation?」

93:t_1:90.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's enough, Princess. I made a special invitation to Colonel $$ハトリ$$ this time.」

93:t_1:91.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The Space Force wants to hear about the other day's incident. I decided having him come here was easier than going there.」

93:t_1:92.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You mean the $$宇宙怪獣$$ entering the atmosphere...」

93:t_1:93.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Honestly... This isn't even our world, yet you still hide behind that treaty and claim extraterritorial rights...」

93:t_1:94.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's who we are: $$フラタニティ$$.」

93:t_1:95.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Hmph... I had $$トップレス$$ like you when I was a child. Just not enough for $$フラタニティ$$ to invite me.」

93:t_1:96.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Thanks to that, I woke from my dream before it was too late.」

93:t_1:98.en:
$$チコ$$
「...Anyway, if the problem is that $$宇宙怪獣$$ entered the atmosphere, isn't the Space Force responsible too?」

93:t_1:99.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「As I said, this is not our world. I admit our defense systems have shortcomings.」

93:t_1:100.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then why don't you work with the people here to fight the $$宇宙怪獣$$?」

93:t_1:101.en:
$$チコ$$
「Or are you scared of clashing with $$サイデリアル$$?」

93:t_1:103.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's enough, $$チコ$$. I have something to discuss with the Space Force, too.」

93:t_1:104.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Will you agree to the cooperation we've repeatedly requested?」

93:t_1:105.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...Our right to fight $$宇宙怪獣$$ outside the Space Force's chain of command is guaranteed by treaty.」

93:t_1:107.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We $$トップレス$$ are the only force that can protect humanity from $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

93:t_1:108.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Only we can operate the $$バスターマシン$$s used against $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

93:t_1:109.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「After all, $$トップレス$$ themselves supply the tremendous energy for the $$バスターマシン$$s and the Exotic Maneuvers that overwhelm $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

93:t_1:111.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「But you could also say this: the $$宇宙怪獣$$ attack because $$トップレス$$ exist...」

93:t_1:113.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Even old records show that the appearance of $$トップレス$$ coincided with the renewed invasion by $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

93:t_1:114.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「This is what I think... Perhaps you're the same... Perhaps you're both enemies of humanity.」

93:t_1:117.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Eventually, I intend to recommend dismantling every system connected to $$フラタニティ$$.」

93:t_1:118.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...I see. Then let me get our business out of the way before that.」

93:t_1:119.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We $$トップレス$$ of $$メガネビュラ$$...」

93:t_2:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

93:t_2:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hear me out...! Hear me out!」

93:t_2:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I know neither my birthplace nor my parents. I'm just a humble soul named $$ノノ$$, raised in Mars' Marineris Valley!」

93:t_2:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Good folks of $c, please share a cup of brotherhood with this $$ノノ$$!」

93:t_2:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Stay out of this, $$ノノ$$. We'll never get anywhere like this.」

93:t_2:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I apologize, everyone in $c. Let me offer our cooperation once more.」

93:t_2:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Are you this unit's commander?」

93:t_2:12.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We're $$フラタニティ$$. We don't have a leader or anything like that.」

93:t_2:14.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It's an organization that brings together children with so-called superpowers: $$トップレス$$.」

93:t_2:15.en:
$$カシオ$$
「$$フラタニティ$$ is basically run entirely by children. Adults cannot interfere.」

93:t_2:17.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I brought everyone's belongings from $$メガネビュラ$$. And as their coach, I need to properly introduce myself to everyone in $c.」

93:t_2:18.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're a coach in name only...」

93:t_2:19.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You mentioned $$トップレス$$ earlier. Do you use that power in combat?」

93:t_2:20.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Yes. Each person's abilities have their own characteristics.」

93:t_2:21.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「For instance, I can manipulate matter remotely, while $$ラルク$$ here can teleport through quantization.」

93:t_2:23.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Most importantly, our $$バスターマシン$$s are powered by Exotic Maneuvers produced through $$トップレス$$ abilities.」

93:t_2:25.en:
$$マオ$$
「So those robots run on your powers?」

93:t_2:26.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Exactly. And that power is unmatched in our world...」

93:t_2:27.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It is also our greatest strength against $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

93:t_2:28.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Did your world have any military forces besides the $$トップレス$$?」

93:t_2:29.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There was an organization called the Space Force. Some of its members have transferred to this world, too.」

93:t_2:30.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But asking them for help is pointless. Their primary mission is intercepting $$宇宙怪獣$$, and they're organized specifically for that.」

93:t_2:31.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That is why they and $$サイデリアル$$ maintain a policy of mutual noninterference.」

93:t_2:32.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then explain why you wish to help us under those circumstances.」

93:t_2:33.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「First, we're $$フラタニティ$$. Our right to act independently of the Space Force is guaranteed, so this is entirely our own decision.」

93:t_2:34.en:
$$チコ$$
('Our' decision, huh... Don't you mean $$ニコラ$$'s decision...?)

93:t_2:35.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And as members of this world, we've learned that $$宇宙怪獣$$ aren't the only enemies of Earth's humanity.」

93:t_2:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You mean $$サイデリアル$$...」

93:t_2:37.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Yes. We've decided to fight them to protect humanity on Earth.」

93:t_2:38.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We would very much like to help you, since you're at the center of that fight.」

93:t_2:39.en:
$$アルト$$
「You sure weren't very cooperative at first, though...」

93:t_2:41.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I apologize for that. Our purpose was to gauge the abilities of the comrades we would be fighting alongside.」

93:t_2:42.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Once again, I apologize for our rudeness. Please allow us to lend $c our assistance.」

93:t_2:43.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...We have no reason to refuse.」

93:t_2:44.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you. Now, let me introduce the members of $$フラタニティ$$.」
